Committee: County and Municipal Government
Sponsor: Baker
Analyst: Julie Knight
Date: 02/09/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 335 as introduced limits the duration of contracts entered into by certain local government entities for collection and disposal of residential solid waste to a period of no more than five years. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Reed Ingram, Chair
County and Municipal Government

FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 335 as passed the House of Representatives limits the duration of contracts entered into by certain local government entities for collection and disposal of residential solid waste to a period of no more than five years. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
